items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta or full launch. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep rights outreach unsent, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics but not redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; public Woot terms restrict commercial/public data use; security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain blocked. Human counsel is required for Woot redistribution/commercial-use rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and any future affiliate, advertising, remarketing, or customer-matching use. Fleet compliance is technical triage only: 36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown; it is not certification. Ordinary reversible growth may proceed only within existing disclosure, consent, provenance, claims, and data-handling boundaries.

SearchWoot launch-readiness remains active and no legal task is closed. Attach one dated read-only evidence bundle to the existing checklist: field-level Woot rights matrix; alert-data flow and retention table; deployed consent/withdrawal and GA4 configuration evidence; and logs, vendors, retention, access, incident, and request-handling inventory. Do not send Woot outreach, enable tracking, expand notifications, change production, or clear the private gate.

Keep the security-sensitive release and private-launch gates unchanged. No security clearance is evidenced: fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results, and site security facts are unknown. Continue the existing read-only control matrix; do not retrieve credentials, alter configuration, deploy, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach.

The existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement is conditionally permissible as ordinary reversible growth after capacity clears. Preserve the adjacent affiliate disclosure, registered destination and tracking ID allthingsmasonic-20, consent and disclosure behavior, claims boundaries, and single-diff rollback. This is not public-launch clearance and no revenue or causal lift may be claimed.

Howtofry.com may receive only a read-only launch-readiness packet while capacity is saturated. No build, publish, domain addition, tracking, affiliate activation, or go-live is cleared. The packet must evidence audience and launch scope, privacy/terms/cookie and affiliate disclosures, provenance and claims, analytics decision, security/release controls, owner assignment, measurement, rollback, and an explicit launch gate.
